decision.explanation: The original sources (D1S1–D1S14) confirm that Enrique Matta Figueroa served as a deputy of Chile and specifically as a member of the Chamber of Deputies of Chile from 1933 to 1937. The second document (D2S2–D2S16) states that he was appointed as the Minister of Finance in Brazil. These claims are supported directly by the quoted text and align with the requested relation (position held). All three answers are distinct and valid based on the provided sources.
